Legal Documentation

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2, 2026 · Compliance with UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45/2021)

Dubai Car Repair Service ("we," "our," or "us"), operating at 222 Al Satwa Rd, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is dedicated to safeguarding your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy details our practices concerning the collection, storage, and handling of information when you browse our website (dubaicarrepairservice.com), contact our workshop, book mobile repairs, or request roadside emergency assistance.

1. Personal Information We Collect

We only gather personal data necessary to execute vehicle repairs, answer inquiries, or provide mobile mechanical dispatch across Dubai:

  • Contact Identifiers: Your name, phone number, WhatsApp contact, and email address when you submit our contact form, request a callback, or reach out via phone or messaging.
  • Vehicle Information: Vehicle make, model, year of manufacture, mileage, VIN (chassis number), and reported mechanical or electrical symptoms needed to procure correct parts and prepare diagnostic assessments.
  • Location Details: Live GPS coordinates, road names, landmark references, or building addresses provided by you when requesting mobile mechanic dispatch, on-site battery replacement, or roadside towing in Dubai.
  • Technical & Browsing Data: Standard server logs, anonymized IP addresses, browser types, and usage data collected via Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics to evaluate site performance.

2. Purpose & Legal Basis for Data Processing

In accordance with the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 regarding Personal Data Protection (PDPL), we process your data on legitimate commercial grounds and contractual fulfillment:

  • Preparing itemized repair estimates and communicating inspection findings.
  • Dispatching mobile mechanics or recovery trucks directly to your specified location in Dubai.
  • Sourcing genuine manufacturer parts and warranty documentation for your vehicle.
  • Maintaining customer repair service histories for warranty claims and follow-up maintenance reminders.
  • Fulfilling legal, accounting, and tax compliance under UAE commercial regulations.

3. Data Sharing & Third Parties

We do not sell, rent, lease, or trade your personal data to external marketers or unauthorized third parties. Data is shared exclusively under strict operational requirements:

  • Authorized Technicians & Recovery Drivers: Location and phone details are provided to our dispatch team strictly to complete your emergency callout or scheduled mobile service.
  • Genuine Parts Distributors: Vehicle chassis numbers (VIN) may be verified with certified UAE parts distributors to ensure OEM compatibility.
  • Digital Service Providers: Secure hosting platforms, Google Tag Manager / Analytics (for site metrics), and WhatsApp Business (for customer messaging).
  • Government & Legal Authorities: Disclosed only if compelled by UAE judicial authority, police request, or statutory regulation.

4. Data Retention & Storage Security

We employ administrative, physical, and electronic security measures to safeguard customer records against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. Customer service records (including repair invoices and warranty dates) are maintained for a standard period of 3 years to support ongoing warranty coverage and vehicle service histories, after which data is securely purged or anonymized.

5. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website uses standard essential and statistical cookies to deliver smooth navigation and monitor aggregate traffic. You can modify your browser settings to decline non-essential cookies. Opting out will not restrict access to our vehicle repair guides, contact information, or direct calling features.

6. Your Privacy Rights Under UAE Law

Under the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, you have the right to:

  • Request confirmation of whether we hold personal data relating to you.
  • Obtain a copy of the personal information stored in our repair records.
  • Request correction of obsolete, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
  • Request deletion of your contact details, subject to statutory tax and warranty record-keeping obligations.
  • Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.

7. Contact & Privacy Inquiries

If you have questions, requests, or privacy concerns regarding this policy, please reach out directly:
